claim: The sample does not create or change a real room
sandbox: Open /demo, resolve a sample turn, and assert no request reaches the real room API.

claim: The landing page makes no third-party tracking request
sandbox: Record every request from a fresh landing-page load and assert all hosts are the product origin.

claim: Resetting the sample starts it again
sandbox: Resolve one sample turn, reset, then observe turn 1 again.
Enable still resolution effects in /demo, reload, and observe the checked setting.

claim: Reloading reconnects to your saved room
sandbox: Create a room, reload the same browser context, and observe the same saved room.

claim: Two people create and join a room without an account or payment
sandbox: Two independent browser contexts create and join a room with names only.
Fill both seats from independent contexts, then assert a third join receives the room-full error.

where: Privacy and limits section, privacy page, and terms
sandbox: Create a room through the live test service and assert its expiry is 24 hours from creation.

claim: A match ends after five simultaneous turns
where: First-screen facts, game instructions, and README
sandbox: Two independent browser contexts submit five rounds and observe the winner end screen.
